title: PAR-134 MLEADER entity-level CMC RGB retention
scope: Retain the three entity-level CMC RGB values specified for MLEADER
Emit retained C2 RGB while preserving indexed C0/C1/C3 behavior
Independently inspect generated wire fields and reject invalid values before output

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: The entity-level leader, style text, and style block colors are CMC fields (DXF groups 91, 92, and 93 respectively); §2.11 defines the R2004+ method-packed CMC representation.

localSource.finding: The bounded parser previously retained only normalized scalar colors and the writer used index-only CMC output. The typed MLEADER model now retains C2 RGB independently for all three fields and emits it through the existing CMC writer.
localSource.compatibility: The appended RGB fields change the public DRW_MLeader class size; consumers must rebuild. No vtable or DRW_Interface callback changed.

generatedControls.finding: The independent wire walk checks all three CMC positions, reserved index, method, payload, flags, and following fields. Parser checks verify normalized scalar/RGB values and the trailing handle sentinel. Invalid 24-bit range and scalar/RGB mismatch are refused before body, string, or handle output.
generatedControls.limit: Generated local vectors do not establish producer validity, native consumer behavior, class-specific DXF truecolor/name semantics, or external semantic qualification.

productionSummary: Append three RGB companions to DRW_MLeader and include them in copy, assignment, and parser reset.
Retain C2 RGB in the bounded parser and emit C2 from the writer when present.
Reject invalid RGB ranges or non-normalized scalar/RGB pairs before entity output.

commands.command: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.h src/drw_entities.cpp tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp CMakeLists.txt

unresolved: DXF truecolor and optional CMC color/book name semantics require their own class-specific contract or producer evidence.
Independent producer and native qualification remain separate gates.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
